verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents file downloads from sites, file uploads to sites, or storage and retrieval of downloaded artifacts after a session. The closest items are adjacent: CDP access for Playwright is a developer building block, and session replays or structured extraction are different features. None of these count as a native file-transfer and artifact capability.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards
